spans.s: जिह्वा used in the sense of जिह्वाग्र, the tip of the tongue.

जिह्वामूलस्थान (l)having the root of the tongue as the place of its produc- tion;the phonetic element or letter called जिह्वामूलीय; (2) name given to that phonetic element into which a visarga is changed when follow- ed by क् or ख्; cf X क
. The जिह्वामूलीय letter is called जिह्व्य also; see Nyasa on
. The Rk. Pratisakhya looks upon ऋ, लृ, जिह्वामूलीय, and the gut- tural letters as जिह्वामूलस्थान.
जिह्वामूलीय produced at the root of the tongue the same as जिह्वामूलस्थान, which see above.
